Proposed Dashboard — Sources, Calculations and Arrangement (6 Oct 2026)

The whole page

Data period as a badge; trend lines on the scholarship and hostel tiles; Beneficiary Students alone under Year by Year Trends; the three Year on Year cards side by side; Share of Fund Release moved beside expenditure under Fund Release and Expenditure. Card titles and labels unchanged.

Source and calculation

Before, the notes sat as text under each figure. Now an info control opens a compact summary on hover or focus.

Select the info control

The sheet sets out the source as a table, with the link to the API, page or file, and the calculation line by line like a price breakup.

A live figure's sheet

NMBA's figure is read from the portal's API; the sheet links the endpoint.
